 Bolex Reporter, Volume 16
 1966
 Volume 16, Number 1
 Articles: "The Avant Garde Cinema", Peter Vanadia; "Twice a Man", Gregory J. Markopoulos; "The New American Cinema Group", Fred W. McDarrah; "Techniques", Maurice Amar; "Film and the New Dance", Ann Halprin; "What To Do With Your Film", Geza de Rosner; "Films for Television", Jim Doney; "What Makes a Good Travelogue?", Martin A. Forrest; "An Unusual Documentary", Edgar J. Thompson; "Grand Canyon Passage", Merton J. Goldsmith; "A Close-up of Nature", P.T. Fetko; "Surfing World-wide", Bruce Brown; "Wildlife", Cartl E. Scott and John E. Swedberg; "Arctic Voyage", Robert W.F. Cundy
 The previous two issues were devoted mainly to the discussion of professional uses of Bolex cameras in commerce, industry and education. In the 3rd and final 'Professional Issue', the use of Bolex cameras in the arts is discussed. "The New American Cinema Group", profiles some of the film-makers of the Avant Garde and underground cinema: Peter Goldman, Marie Menken, Naomi Levine, Ken Jacobs, Stan Vanderbeek, Gregory Markopoulos, Robert Breer, Robert Frank, David Brooks, Jack Smith, Buddy Wirtschaefter, Jerry Malanga, Andy Warhol and Jonas Mekas.
